svg.text: TileMega: A Unified Compiler Framework for Efficient Megakernel Generation for LLM Inference
Lower compute regions to CuTe / CUDA
CuTe: layout / tile mapping, TMA, tensor
Custom CUDA for non-GEMM task bodies
Task bodies packed into one persistent
Only when required by deployment target
Task space + access maps → task dependences
ISL derives RAW couplings between producer and consumer task tiles.
Dep(P→C) = compose / inverse / project over access relations
Cost model ranks → Top-N are autotuned
Best measured candidate is written back to the CG IR.
Key: CG = Coupling Graph · ISL = Integer Set Library · CTA = Cooperative Thread Array · SM = Streaming Multiprocessor · TMA = Tensor Memory Accelerator
